notes: New: Personality. Every monster now rolls one of 8 personalities at capture or hatch, fixed for life and shown on its Inspect screen. Half are stat trade-offs (Aggressive, Guarded, Swift, Sturdy, Reckless, Calm); the other half are passive perks that don't touch stats (Focused adds dodge/flee chance, Adaptive cuts Hunger/Energy drain while exploring).
Splicing two parents in the Splice Lab gives the hybrid a coin-flip chance at either parent's personality.
